location.exact_quote: 一般名詞。辞書には on suspicion of ... を逮捕理由として用いる例がある。Merriam-Webster は法的な suspicion を、証明やわずかな証拠しかない段階で、何かが間違っている、またはある事実が存在すると考える、通常は信念に至らない心理状態として説明する。

Keep it only if the prima facie relation is stated at the target; otherwise remove that extra claim from this claim-unit association.
findings.suggested_direction: Limit the claim unit to what definition:001/register:001 actually say, or add the prima facie-proof relation to the article and associate the House of Lords source with that text.
findings.resolution: Re-scope the legal claim and integrated source union to the Merriam-Webster definition actually stated in the article. Move the House of Lords prima facie-proof fact to an excluded source union because that relation is not stated by either mapped article target.
